hooks.command: bash -c 'missing=""; for t in stylua selene lune rojo; do command -v $t >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing="$missing $t"; done; if [ -n "$missing" ]; then echo "Toolchain missing:$missing - run ./scripts/setup-cloud.sh (first run takes several minutes; see docs/TECH.md section 4)."; else echo "Toolchain ready. Run ./scripts/check.sh before pushing."; fi'
bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.luau|*.lua) command -v stylua >/dev/null 2>&1 && stylua "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac'
